name: Lumos MOS 2
summary: A 1.65 m, up to 350 kg wheeled dual-arm robot with a camera head that lifts 30 kg rated (50 kg max) with both arms and runs 8 h on swappable batteries, sold from China on request.

germany.statusNote: Lumos has offices only in Shenzhen and Suzhou and takes purchase inquiries by web form; no EU distributor, office or customer found. A US-run German-language shop (Roboter Deutschland) lists a 'MOS' as a quote item without a real price.

specs.label: Step crossing
specs.conditions: up to; trench crossing up to 35 mm

specs.label: Hot-swappable battery
specs.conditions: 2 x 19.5 Ah LiFePO4, 48 V; manual swap standard, automatic swap or dock charging optional

specs.label: Sensors
specs.value: 2 base 3D LiDARs, 2 wrist cameras, head camera, bumper strip, 2 six-axis force-torque sensors

specs.label: Development
specs.value: SDK plus graphical task orchestration; VR teleoperation

notes: Payload is stated for both arms together (30 kg rated, 50 kg max); per-arm value not stated.
Factory floors only: 5 % slope, 25 mm steps, 35 mm gaps.
Standard flange with quick-swap end effectors and dexterous hands; which tool ships as standard is not stated.
Listed as a humanoid because it has a camera head and two arms on a wheeled base; the maker calls it a wheeled mobile manipulation robot.

evidence.task: Visual inspection and quality checks, heavy-load transfer and teleoperated work in hazardous areas in factories
evidence.note: Maker scenarios; partners named on the about page (Mitsubishi Electric China, COSCO SHIPPING) without a named MOS task.

openQuestions: The shop lists 'MOS' without a generation; the maker now shows MOS 2 (MOS 1 launched 2025-08). Which one the shop would deliver is unknown.
